# Design

A Rex app is a directory of declarations plus React components. The Vite plugin discovers the app by convention and exposes it as a virtual module. The server mounts every Action as an oRPC procedure behind its Policy and records each call in the audit ledger. The client builds routes, navigation, palette, shortcuts and the sidecar from the same declarations. The checker reads the same structure and fails the build on violations. The manifest is the single generated artifact every projection reads.
